title: SECURITY: Fix URL validation bypass in WebSocket connection
description: CodeQL Alert #4: useWebSocket.tsx uses url.includes('scrummonsters.com') which allows bypass attacks like evil.com/scrummonsters.com. Must use proper hostname validation with URL API. See github-security-report.md for details.
notes: Fixed in commit 15f2a75. Using exact hostname match and .endsWith() validation instead of .includes().

title: SECURITY: Replace Math.random() with crypto-secure random
description: CodeQL Alert #3: gameState.ts line 33 uses Math.random() in security context for generating tokens/IDs. Must use crypto.randomBytes() instead. Predictable random numbers can be exploited. See github-security-report.md for details.
notes: Fixed in commit fc73788. Using crypto.createHash() instead of Math.random() for token generation.

title: After-image effect doesn't track vertical position when fly combined with haste/slow
description:
When a player uses 'fly' emote in lobby and also has 'haste' or 'slow' effect active, the after-image trail only follows horizontal (x) position but ignores vertical (y) position changes.

Expected: After-images should trail behind player in both x and y dimensions
Actual: After-images only follow x position, stay at same y level

Affected files:
- client/src/components/game/Lobby.tsx (after-image rendering logic)
- Likely around haste/slow effect state management

Related: Phase 21 (Lobby Magic) - implemented ad-hoc, needs formal polish

title: SECURITY: Add rate limiting to auth and API routes
description: CodeQL Alerts #1,2,5-13 (10 total): Missing rate limiting on auth routes, profile routes, and vite routes. Enables brute force attacks, API abuse, and DoS. Install express-rate-limit and add to: server/auth/routes.ts (4 endpoints), server/auth/profileRoutes.ts (4 endpoints), server/vite.ts (2 endpoints). See github-security-report.md for configuration.
notes: Implementation documented in REMAINING-SECURITY-FIXES.md. Requires npm install express-rate-limit in deployment environment.

title: Ctrl key attack in battle doesn't damage boss
description:
In the boss battle screen, pressing Ctrl key queues up an attack animation but doesn't actually trigger the boss damage event.

Expected: Ctrl key should deal damage to boss (same as clicking)
Actual: 
- Visual attack animation plays
- No damage numbers appear
- Boss HP doesn't decrease

Clicking works correctly and shows damage points.

Affected files:
- client/src/components/game/PlayerController.tsx (keyboard attack handling)
- Likely missing socket.emit for attack_boss event on Ctrl key press

Related: Battle phase mechanics
